paragraphs.text: That is, keep them in your heart.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: If you give yourself to the true knowledge of God without hypocrisy.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: Meaning that we must seek the knowledge of God with care and diligence.
paragraphs.label: c
paragraphs.anchor: liftest up thy voice for understanding

paragraphs.text: Showing that no labour must be spared.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: This (he says) is the true wisdom to know and fear God.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: The word of God will guide you, and teach you how to govern yourself.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: That is, the word of God, which is the only light, to follow their own fantasies which are darkness.
paragraphs.label: g

paragraphs.text: When they see any given to evil as they are.
paragraphs.label: h
paragraphs.anchor: in the frowardness of the wicked

paragraphs.text: Meaning, the wisdom which is the word of God, will preserve us from all vices: naming this vice of whoredom to which man is most prone.
paragraphs.label: i

paragraphs.text: That is, her husband, who is her head and guide to govern her, from whom she ought not to depart, but remain in his subjection.
paragraphs.label: k

paragraphs.text: Her acquaintance with her spirits and they that haunt her.
paragraphs.label: m

paragraphs.text: To them who are dead in body and soul.
paragraphs.label: n

paragraphs.text: They will enjoy the temporal and spiritual promises of God, as the wicked will be void of them.
paragraphs.label: o
